name: Octyl palmitate
description: Octyl palmitate (CAS 16958-85-3 ), also known as octyl hexadecanoate, is a fatty acid ester derived from palmitic acid and octanol. It functions as an emollient, lubricant, and plasticizer across personal care and industrial formulations. This versatile ester delivers a smooth, non-greasy skin feel in cosmetics and reduces friction in mechanical applications. In personal care, it is used in skin creams, sunscreens, and color cosmetics to improve spreadability. It provides a lightweight, silky texture without heaviness, making it ideal for high-end skincare. Coating and adhesive formulators incorporate it as a plasticizer to enhance film flexibility and substrate adhesion. In metalworking and industrial lubricant formulations, it acts as a base fluid or additive to reduce surface friction. This improves processing performance and extends the lifespan of mechanical components in various systems. It also functions as a dispersing aid in pigment concentrates, helping achieve uniform color distribution. This is critical for both cosmetic and coating systems where consistency and visual appeal are paramount for the end user. Octyl palmitate is supplied as a clear to pale yellow liquid. It is available in cosmetic-grade and technical-grade specifications, with cosmetic-grade material commonly meeting purity standards for manufacturing. Our product ensures compliance with rigorous industry requirements for stability and performance.
